summary: Millrose Properties filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, reporting entry into a Commitment and Acceptance under its March 25, 2026 Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. The agreement adds Flagstar Bank, N.A. as a new lender and exercises the accordion to raise aggregate revolving commitments by $50 million to $1.385 billion, with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent. No price, premium, stake, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine credit-facility upsize and lender addition, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
